property_summary: After any successful call to newEmergencyOracle by the owner, the state variable jojoTeam remains unchanged.
After any call to newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle is the sender (msg.sender).
After any call to newEmergencyOracle(string) by any caller, the contract's jojoTeam address remains unchanged.
Only the jojoTeam address can successfully call newEmergencyOracle without reverting.
